records.jp: 伶那さん、勇希！
records.en_original: Rena, Yuki!
records.en: Rena, Yuki!

records.jp: おーい！　みんなー！
records.en_original: Guys, over here!
records.en: Guys, over here!

records.jp: 見て、これ
records.en_original: Look at this.
records.en: Look at this.

records.jp: 前に見た時と違う……光ってる？
records.en_original: It's different from last time... It's shining?
records.en: It's different from last time... It's shining?

records.jp: わ、また鳴った
records.en_original: Oh, my phone is ringing again.
records.en: Oh, my phone is ringing again.

records.jp: はよ～ん！　リフナビちゃんだよ☆
records.en_original: Hello hello hello! It's everyone's favorite, ReSource!
records.en: Hello hello hello! It's everyone's favorite, ReSource!

records.jp: 新しいココロトープを開放したんだね！<CR>やるじゃん☆
records.en_original: You've opened a new Heartscape, huh? Not bad, not bad!
records.en: You've opened a new Heartscape, huh? Not bad, not bad!

records.jp: あー！　あたしたちが付けた名前パクらないでよ！
records.en_original: Hey! We came up with that name, you know!
records.en: Hey! We came up with that name, you know!

records.jp: でも、その方がキミたちにはわかりやすいでしょ？<CR>良い名前だし使わせてもらうよ☆
records.en_original: It's easier for you to understand this way, right? Besides, it's a sweet name and I wanna use it.
records.en: It's easier for you to understand this way, right? Besides, it's a sweet name and I wanna use it.

records.jp: 相変わらず偉そうな……
records.en_original: Annoying as always...
records.en: Annoying as always...

records.jp: 早速行き先を切り替えて、<CR>詩帆ちゃんのココロトープに行こう☆
records.en_original: You just need to change your destination and you'll be off to Miss Shiho's Heartscape.
records.en: You just need to change your destination and you'll be off to Miss Shiho's Heartscape.

records.jp: 行き先を切り替える？　何それ
records.en_original: Change the destination? What do you mean?
records.en: Change the destination? What do you mean?

records.jp: 近くに船の舵があるでしょ？<CR>それをグルっと回せば別の世界に行けるゾ☆
records.en_original: See the ship's wheel over there? You can spin it to choose the world you want to visit!
records.en: See the ship's wheel over there? You can spin it to choose the world you want to visit!

records.jp: そんじゃ、良き旅を～☆
records.en_original: Have a good trip!
records.en: Have a good trip!

records.jp: この舵のことかな……
records.en_original: I guess this must be the wheel.
records.en: I guess this must be the wheel.

records.jp: なんでこんなとこに舵が……？
records.en_original: What's a wheel doing here anyway?
records.en: What's a wheel doing here anyway?

records.jp: 元からあったよね？<CR>誰が置いたのか知らないけど
records.en_original: It's always been here, hasn't it? No idea who put it here, though.
records.en: It's always been here, hasn't it? No idea who put it here, though.

records.jp: この世界に元からある仕組みってこと？<CR>誰が……？　何のために？
records.en_original: You mean it's been part of this world from the beginning? But who created it...? And for what?
records.en: You mean it's been part of this world from the beginning? But who created it...? And for what?

records.jp: よく分かんないけど、ひとまずこれを回せば<CR>詩帆さんのココロトープに行けるんだよね
records.en_original: No idea. All we can do is turn this and go to Shiho's Heartscape.
records.en: No idea. All we can do is turn this and go to Shiho's Heartscape.

records.jp: わたしの……ココロトープ……
records.en_original: My Heartscape...
records.en: My Heartscape...

records.jp: ……どうしたの？
records.en_original: ...What's wrong?
records.en: ...What's wrong?

records.jp: 靭さんは、怖くなかったですか？
records.en_original: Were you afraid, Kokoro?
records.en: Were you afraid, Kokoro?

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: わたし、怖いんです……。<CR>そのココロトープって、心の世界なんですよね？
records.en_original: I'm afraid. A Heartscape is a world constructed from my heart, isn't that right?
records.en: I'm afraid. A Heartscape is a world constructed from my heart, isn't that right?

records.jp: そこを歩き回って、わたしの心がどうにかなったりは<CR>しないんでしょうか？
records.en_original: Could going inside have some kind of negative effect on my heart?
records.en: Could going inside have some kind of negative effect on my heart?

records.jp: それに、その中に人に見せられないような<CR>“わたし”が居たらと思うと……
records.en_original: And what if there's a part of me in there I'd rather keep hidden?
records.en: And what if there's a part of me in there I'd rather keep hidden?

records.jp: みなさんを入れるのも、怖いです
records.en_original: What if you see something terrible?
records.en: What if you see something terrible?

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃん……
records.en_original: Shiho...
records.en: Shiho...

records.jp: ……確かにちょっと、怖さはあったのです
records.en_original: ...To be honest, I was a little scared.
records.en: ...To be honest, I was a little scared.

records.jp: でも、記憶を失くす前のことを知りたかったし……<CR>愛央ちゃんのために、この世界について調べたかった
records.en_original: But I wanted to know what happened before I lost my memory, and find out more about this world. For Ao.
records.en: But I wanted to know what happened before I lost my memory, and find out more about this world. For Ao.

records.jp: それと……みんなには言ってなかったけどね
records.en_original: And... I didn't mention this to anyone, but...
records.en: And... I didn't mention this to anyone, but...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんが、うらやましかったんだ
records.en_original: I was jealous of Ao.
records.en: I was jealous of Ao.

records.en_original: What? Of me?
records.en: What? Of me?

records.jp: 帰りたいって思えるということは、<CR>帰る先に大切な何かがあるということで
records.en_original: I figured that the fact that you wanted to go home so badly means that you must have something important waiting for you there.
records.en: I figured that the fact that you wanted to go home so badly means that you must have something important waiting for you there.

records.jp: それはつまり、大切な思い出が<CR>何かしらあるということで
records.en_original: That you must have very special memories and people there waiting for you.
records.en: That you must have very special memories and people there waiting for you.

records.jp: それが、うらやましかった
records.en_original: That's what I was jealous of.
records.en: That's what I was jealous of.

records.jp: だから記憶を取り戻して確かめたかったのです
records.en_original: So I wanted to get my memory back and show everyone.
records.en: So I wanted to get my memory back and show everyone.

records.jp: 本当の靭こころは、<CR>大切な思い出をたくさん持ってるんだ！って
records.en_original: Like, "I am the real Kokoro Utsubo! I have lots of special memories of my own!"
records.en: Like, "I am the real Kokoro Utsubo! I have lots of special memories of my own!"

records.jp: こころ……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: そんな風に、思ってたんだ……
records.en_original: I had no idea you felt that way...
records.en: I had no idea you felt that way...

records.jp: ねえ、詩帆ちゃん。<CR>一緒に、本当の詩帆ちゃんを見つけに行こう？
records.en_original: Hey, Shiho. Let's go find the real you together.
records.en: Hey, Shiho. Let's go find the real you together.

records.jp: ……わたしにも、大切な思い出があるでしょうか
records.en_original: Do you think I have memories like those too?
records.en: Do you think I have memories like those too?

records.jp: きっとあるのです。<CR>もし、無かったらそのときは……
records.en_original: I'm sure you do. And if you don't...
records.en: I'm sure you do. And if you don't...

records.jp: ここで、一緒に思い出を作っていこう
records.en_original: We can make some new ones together.
records.en: We can make some new ones together.

records.jp: 靭さん……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: ……わかりました。<CR>わたし、行ってみようと思います
records.en_original: ...Okay. I'd like to go.
records.en: ...Okay. I'd like to go.

records.jp: ……うん！
records.en_original: All right!
records.en: All right!

records.jp: よーし、それじゃあ準備ができたら行こっか！
records.en_original: Well, if everyone's ready, let's do this thing!
records.en: Well, if everyone's ready, let's do this thing!

records.jp: ところで、あなたたち一体何があったの？<CR>突然スマホに通知来たけど……
records.en_original: By the way, what happened to you three, anyways? We got a notification on our phones all of a sudden.
records.en: By the way, what happened to you three, anyways? We got a notification on our phones all of a sudden.

records.jp: みんなでコーヒーを飲んでた
records.en_original: We had a cup of coffee together.
records.en: We had a cup of coffee together.

records.jp: それだけ……？
records.en_original: That's it?
records.en: That's it?

records.jp: きっと、何か理由があるんだよ
records.en_original: There must be some reason for it.
records.en: There must be some reason for it.

records.jp: はい。わたしもそう思います
records.en_original: Yes. I think so too.
records.en: Yes. I think so too.

records.jp: もしかしたら、その答えが……。<CR>ココロトープの中にあるのかもしれません
records.en_original: I have a feeling we may find that reason somewhere in the Heartscape.
records.en: I have a feeling we may find that reason somewhere in the Heartscape.
